strongest_changes: The repeated إِن + كُنتُم frame turns 44:7 certainty and 44:50 imtirāʾ into a sharp epistemic reversal.
The context's speech acts and claim-to-judgment sequence recast doubt as public repudiation that matures into enforceable liability.
The tree-food-molten-boiling-pouring-taste chain externalizes contentious speech as an embodied consequence returned to its speakers.
Watching, arrival, separation, and the adjacent secure station make the focus both a temporal arrival and a boundary between realized positions.
A distributed set of pressure, flow, and yield branches keeps the odd draw-out sense of م ر ي live rather than collapsing it into ordinary doubt.
summary.what_was_special: The split م ر ي mapping sustained several coexisting mechanisms: inward hesitation, adversarial denial, extracted yield, oscillating motion, and friction that can strike fire. Context did not select one winner; it made different readings functional at different scales, especially through the exact dispute branch inside ش ج ر and the station contrast after the focus.
remaining_uncertainties: هَٰذَا may point narrowly to the immediate punishment, more broadly to an adjudicated liability, or compositionally to the station sealed at the verse boundary.
The draw-out, oscillation, hard-stone, and distributed lactation readings are visibly anchored but branch-distant and should remain exploratory.
The ironic rank reversal after 44:49 and the post-focus untangling of language depend on inferred compositional arrows rather than explicit packet directionality.
